描述_EN: mandeville and olympic mascot wenlock were designed by london-based company iris, and inspired by a short story by children’s author michael morpurgo which told how they were formed by drops of steel in the production of the olympic stadium. mandeville is the official paralympic mascot for london 2012. aimed at children to promote london 2012, the mascots star in their own short film, have a social media presence and appear on a wide range of merchandise. the character features a camera lens for an eye, a taxi light on top of his head, and the three points on its head represent the paralympic symbol. the name comes from stoke mandeville hospital in aylesbury, buckinghamshire, which held games that inspired the modern paralympics.
描述_ZN: 曼德维尔和奥运会吉祥物温洛克是由总部设在伦敦的IRIS公司设计的，其灵感来自于儿童文学作家迈克尔-莫普戈的一个短篇故事，该故事讲述了他们是如何在奥运场馆的建设中由钢滴形成的。 曼德维尔是2012年伦敦残奥会的官方吉祥物。 以儿童为目标来宣传2012年伦敦奥运会，吉祥物在他们自己的短片中出演，在社交媒体上出现，并出现在各种商品上。 这个角色的特点是眼睛是照相机镜头，头顶上有一个出租车灯，头上的三个点代表残奥会的标志。 这个名字来自于白金汉郡艾尔斯伯里的斯托克-曼德维尔医院，该医院举办的比赛激发了现代残奥会。
